description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You force a meld on a creature within reach, and your nervous system does what it was born to do: it overwhelms theirs and feeds on what it burns.

The target takes @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[mental]] damage (1d6 per two levels, rounded up) with a basic @Check[will|against:class-dc|basic] save against your class DC. If it fails, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level for 1 minute. On a critical failure it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 1}.

A willing or helpless creature automatically fails the save.
